followup_reviews.Research finding: The Manzhouli episode and its separate rail-operational and road-policy phases remain included and source-supported. P1 is Russia-to-China returning non-container timber/mineral-powder imports. P2 is China-to-Russia road exports. Container/LPG trains and 2023 passenger coaches do not broaden these cohorts. Retain P1 1 December 2021–14 January 2022, 44 days with observed rail arrivals; P2 3 December–14 January, 42 policy days with legal-effective endpoint and zero operational flags. January 13 reporting of next-day permission is not road passage. Keep Health and biosecurity / Human disease control as locally attributed COVID controls; do not recode based on unexamined commercial effects. NHC-hosted China Daily and CNR indexed body were freshly read. Saved CNS/CRI and Sohu passages were reread; a government host or unverified account does not create extra independent confirmation. Both phases remain unlocated and distinct by transport mode and direction. No general Manzhouli point, rail arrival position or road first-pass marker is invented.
